title: Maple taffy on snow ASMR
summary: A satisfying close-up of hot maple syrup setting into taffy on fresh snow, with crunchy, sticky sound.
why: Satisfying close-up ASMR clips (pouring, slicing, crunching) are still among the most watched AI videos. This one has a Canadian twist that stands out from the usual glass-fruit cutting.
steps: Use a video model that can make sound, or add sound effects afterwards.
Keep the clip short and loop it.

prompts.label: Main prompt
prompts.text: Extreme close-up, macro lens: hot amber maple syrup pours in a slow, glossy ribbon onto a tray of fresh white snow, steaming slightly. It sets into a soft golden strip of taffy, and a wooden stick presses in and rolls it up slowly. Crisp daylight, shallow depth of field, crunchy snow and sticky pulling sounds, no music. 8 seconds.

prompts.label: Variation: wax seal
prompts.text: Macro close-up: a stick of deep red sealing wax melts and drips onto cream paper, then a brass stamp presses in and lifts away, leaving a crisp maple-leaf seal. Soft warm light, satisfying press and peel sound, no music. 6 seconds.

prompts.label: Variation: for a café
prompts.text: Macro close-up of a barista pouring steamed milk into an espresso, forming a slow, perfect leaf pattern, then a spoon taps the cup. Morning window light, gentle pouring and clink sounds, no music. 7 seconds, 9:16.

tips: Write "no music". Clean sound is the point of ASMR.
Macro clips hide small AI mistakes, so they're a good first video project.
Loop the best 3 seconds for Reels and Shorts.
